title: Certify integrality cuts through floors of Real terms in qf_lira
summary: qf_lira proofs now certify integrality cuts through floors of Real terms on both cores, by projecting each such step onto its Int atoms and stating the result through existing cast lemmas. All 330 unsat runs of random floor seeds 1-400 now verify in Lean, with no new axiom, lemma or sorry.
